title: Professor of Practice
bio: Scott Westfahl is a Professor of Practice and the Director of HLS Executive Education. Within the law school’s J.D. curriculum, he teaches a Leadership Fundamentals Workshop for first-year law students, and team-based courses on adaptive leadership and design thinking and innovation. In 2024, his course Legal Innovation Through Design Thinking was recognized by Bloomberg Law […]
